name: cpython-clang
summary: CPython 3.13.5 (clang-built) + stdlib — real Python. No sockets/asyncio, no ssl/https/pip, no ctypes.

bin/cpython-clang.content:
#!/bin/sh
# cpython-clang launcher (todos/0340, CPYTHON.md §5.3; spawn-free per 0444).
#
# CPython finds its stdlib by walking up from the resolved executable to
# lib/python3.13/os.py — no PYTHONHOME, no PYTHONPATH, relocatable. The one
# variable set here is the pyc cache location: gucman's remove is checksum
# gated and unlinks only what it planted, so runtime __pycache__/ dirs written
# under /opt would strand skeleton directories at removal. Sending them to
# /var/cache keeps /opt pristine and puts the cache where a factory reset
# (wipe /etc + /var) already clears it.
#
# Self-location is a known-prefix probe (todos/0444): the package lives at
# /opt/<name> installed or /usr/opt/<name> baked — the only two plant sites
# (gucman install / the os-common.js fold). `[` is a hush builtin, so the
# probe spawns nothing; the old dirname-of-realpath command substitution cost
# four processes per launch. /opt wins when both exist (installed-over-baked,
# the same rule that puts /usr/local/bin ahead of /bin on PATH). The launcher
# is VARIABLE-FREE — only builtins and literal paths — because plain shell
# assignments in script files are broken under the default boot env (#296);
# the one-line export form is the working store path.
export PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/var/cache/cpython-clang
[ -d /opt/cpython-clang ] && exec /opt/cpython-clang/bin/cpython-clang.wasm "$@"
exec /usr/opt/cpython-clang/bin/cpython-clang.wasm "$@"
